WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code,
         st.healtheval AS health_safety_status,
         AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_scan_minute,
         COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  WHERE s.chronotag::text BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
    AND s.gbsize IS NOT NULL
    AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.healtheval
), overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_scan_minute) AS mean_group_average
  FROM group_averages
)
SELECT g.site_code,
       g.health_safety_status,
       g.avg_gb_per_scan_minute,
       g.scan_count,
       g.avg_gb_per_scan_minute - m.mean_group_average AS amount_above_mean
FROM group_averages AS g
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
WHERE m.mean_group_average IS NOT NULL
  AND g.avg_gb_per_scan_minute > m.mean_group_average
ORDER BY amount_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
